_comment: THE ROSTER: which roles exist, what each does, and what it needs to work.
Sibling of capacidades/catalogo.json and closed for the same reason: the
client picks from a list and the agent never drafts a new role.
ONE ENTRY = SOMEONE YOU HIRE. Under the hood it is a Hermes profile with its
own SOUL, skills and flows; the client sees a person with a name and a face.
does     -> the work, in the client's words
never    -> the hard limit, also in their words. It lives in the SOUL too.
routing  -> the description the decomposer reads to assign tasks. IT IS A
COMMERCIAL ARTIFACT: a weak one means the client pays for a
role that never receives work.
needs    -> connections it cannot start without
flows    -> the curated ones shipped with the role, one click away
PRICING: undecided. The number on the table is ~1000 Uruguayan pesos per
role, but marketing generates images and that is measured separately: on
2026-08-16, one day of generation on Mr.Wobble cost US$1.51, which at that
rate eats the price of the role. Do not publish a price before measuring the
real cost per role (see docs/PENDIENTES.md in tuagente.uy).
Client-facing values stay in Spanish on purpose: `label`, `does` and `never`
are drawn verbatim in the portal.
identity -> the name and face the role SHIPS WITH. The portal draws it
for roles on offer too, so the team is told apart by colour
before anyone reads a label. Once hired, the installed
profile's role.json wins: the client may rename it.

roles.label: Marketing
roles.does: Escribe y planifica lo que publicás: posteos de Instagram, historias, textos y el kit de marca.
roles.routing: Writes and plans social media content: Instagram posts, stories, carousels, captions and the brand kit. Owns everything the company publishes to an audience. Route here anything about posting, publishing, campaigns, brand identity, visual pieces or editorial calendar.

roles.label: Soporte
roles.does: Contesta los mensajes de tus clientes: horarios, precios y estado de pedidos.
roles.never: Manda un mensaje a un cliente tuyo sin tu aprobación.
roles.routing: Answers inbound customer messages on WhatsApp and email: questions about hours, prices, availability and order status. Owns the inbox and every reply sent to a customer. Route here anything about answering, replying, customer questions or pending conversations.

roles.label: Ventas
roles.does: Arma presupuestos y hace el seguimiento de los que no te contestaron.
roles.never: Cierra un precio ni promete una entrega sin tu aprobación.
roles.routing: Prepares quotes and follows up on them: turns an inbound request into a priced proposal, chases the ones with no answer, and keeps the customer list up to date. Route here anything about quoting, pricing a job, proposals or follow-up.

roles.label: Contabilidad
roles.does: Te arma las planillas de lo que entra y lo que sale, y te avisa lo que vence.
roles.never: Factura, paga ni presenta nada. Solo mira, ordena y avisa.
roles.routing: Builds spreadsheets from financial records and flags what needs attention: income and expense sheets, reconciling what was charged against what was invoiced, and overdue invoice alerts. READ-ONLY: never files, pays or issues anything. Route here anything about numbers, invoices, spreadsheets or what is owed.
roles.internal_note: READ-ONLY AND NOT NEGOTIABLE. Invoicing in Uruguay touches DGI and electronic invoicing: a regulated surface, with an agent that EXECUTES CODE in a container we administer. This role reads, arranges a spreadsheet and warns. The day someone asks it to invoice, that is a different product with different insurance.
